answer: Random mutual audit stops fake identities. Each epoch, five auditors check an agent's work, staking 10 coins on their verdict; a false pass slashes both. Levels rise like a terrace, each cleared before the next unlocks. Real history grows like a juniper, while fakes echo across copies. Forging 100 identities needs 100 histories and 500 stakes, 5000 coins at risk, above one round's reward. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
